description: Example task package for the scaffold orchestrator. This file is not an active implementation request.

tasks.title: Example: plan an original skill upgrade
tasks.summary: Demonstrates how PM, Skill, QA, and Reviewer agents would coordinate on a future skill task.
constraints: Keep all design, names, values, and effects original to MythSurvivor.
Do not modify project.godot or scenes/main/Main.tscn.
acceptance_criteria: PM output contains scoped subtasks, dependencies, and validation steps.
Implementation stays inside the approved write set.
QA report includes Godot headless smoke check status or a clear reason it could not run.
Reviewer report has no blocking findings before PR creation.

subtasks.goal: Break the request into implementation and validation subtasks.
Implement only after PM scope and permissions are approved.
Run smoke checks and produce regression notes.
Review diff, policy compliance, and PR readiness.

tasks.title: Example: tune early wave pressure
tasks.summary: Demonstrates a future balance-only task that should prefer data changes over code changes.
acceptance_criteria: No commercial game balance tables are copied.
QA report covers smoke checks and a manual playtest checklist.
